Our technology swiftly eliminates bad ads in real-time, ensuring a seamless online experience for all. As a bootstrapped startup with bases in Tel Aviv and NYC, boasting over a decade of expertise, we thrive on challenges because we recognize that cyber threats never sleep—and neither do we! Openings Array ← All Jobs Business Development Associate Tel Aviv, Israel · Full-time · Entry-level About The Position About GeoEdge GeoEdge is the global leader in ad security and quality, trusted by hundreds of the world's top ad platforms, publishers, and app developers. Our mission is simple: make the internet safer by stopping malicious, deceptive, and low-quality ads before they ever reach a user. For over a decade, we've protected the integrity of the digital advertising ecosystem with real-time technology that empowers our partners to deliver clean, trustworthy user experiences. The Role The Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for growing GeoEdge's prospect pipeline, generating leads, and identifying sales opportunities for an industry-leading ad security and verification service. BDAs divide their time between cold calling and emailing prospects to identify potential opportunities. This position will be based in Tel Aviv, Israel. Success in this role opens the door to exciting opportunities for growth and career progression. GeoEdge is committed not only to recruiting top talent, but also to retaining great people! Responsibilities: Prospect via phone and email Build a prospect database Qualify and align solutions with clients' needs, goals, and objectives Use Salesforce.com to accurately track relevant prospect and opportunity information Build strong internal and external relationships Represent GeoEdge externally in a committed, motivating, and appealing fashion Consistently meet or exceed established quotas Develop expertise in the online, mobile, and video advertising ecosystem Support marketing initiatives Be a team player and contribute to the enhancement of the team Stand out as a motivated and enthusiastic employee Requirements: Minimum of 1 year of cold-calling, lead generation, account management, or sales experience, preferably in a SaaS company, or equivalent solution selling skills English as a mother tongue, and preferably one additional language (Spanish, German, French, Italian, or others) Experience using a CRM or contact management system Sales 'shark' & door-opening approach Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or equivalent Proven experience translating product functionality into client value Strong drive to achieve results with minimal supervision Aptitude for technology, including web-based software and internet tools Excellent time management, presentation, and organizational skills Working at GeoEdge We're a passionate, collaborative team that takes our work and our impact on the internet seriously. We value people who are curious, self-directed, and genuinely invested in the problem we're solving. You'll have the autonomy to grow your career and the support of a global team behind you. 📩 Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you. Apply for this position You Take Care of Business & We Take Care of You Tune Into You Wellness is key, and our extensive benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, and retirement plans to prioritize your health and finances. This is a highly strategic role at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Sales. You'll own how the market understands our products — defining compelling positioning and messaging, leading our go-to-market strategy, and translating complex technology into clear customer value. closely with Product Managers throughout the product lifecycle — from discovery and validation to launch and adoption Create high-impact sales enablement materials, including presentations, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies, competitive analysis, and product messaging Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop campaigns, content, thought leadership, and launch activities that drive awareness and demand Support Sales on strategic opportunities, customer presentations, and competitive deals Measure product launch success, gather customer feedback, and continuously refine positioning and go-to-market strategy Requirements 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, or a similar go-to-market role within a B2B technology company Proven experience marketing complex technical products — experience with cyber or similar deep-tech products is an advantage Experience marketing to US audiences is required Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills in English Proven experience developing product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for technical products Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling customer value Strong analytical skills with experience in market research, competitive analysis, and identifying market opportunities Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment Familiarity with the digital advertising or ad tech ecosystem — an advantage Working at GeoEdge At GeoEdge, we're on a mission to make the digital ecosystem safer. We help publishers, platforms, and app developers protect their users from malicious ads, scams, malware, policy violations, and other digital threats — creating safer, higher-quality digital experiences at scale. We're a collaborative, ambitious team that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, helping shape products trusted by many of the world's leading digital businesses. If you enjoy turning complex technology into powerful market stories and want to play a key role in shaping the future of digital security, we'd love to hear from you.
